text: After two boys vanish while livestreaming inside the abandoned Gonjiam Psychiatric Hospital, the owner of the web channel Horror Times sends six people to broadcast [a night inside the asylum|threat|evil places] and [chase a million views|trigger|need and greed]. Rumour says the hospital's director murdered every patient, and no one has ever opened Room 402. The crew's staged scares soon give way to real ones: objects move by themselves, a woman's arm is dragged into a hole in a closet, and the sound of [a ping-pong ball|images|gatherings, games and closeness] returns in the dark.
